profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test at Natera
profile.summary:
Completed a professional certification named Google IT Automation using Python
Experience working with web technologies namely HTTP, JSP, Javascript and the Java programming language. 
Experience working with J2EE Application Servers (Apache Tomcat) and relational 
databases (mysql and MSSQL)
Experience in working with HL7 standards and HL7 interfaces namely ORU, ORM, DFT, ADT,SIU 
Experience in identifying and correcting business critical issues reported by customers.
Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills, including poise in pressure situations
Excellent customer relations skills and organization skills
Ability to work in a flexible, team environment

positions.title: Interfaces Analyst and Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Identify critical patient safety issues and determine root cause within EMR data flows in under 5 day SLA.
•	Create test cases based on the assessment of an issue and document the findings in JIRA
•	Compose test plans that outline the testing approach for improving product quality.
•	Create CRUD SQL queries using multiple joins to retrieve data from the database holding about 0.5 million records.
•	Troubleshoot HL7 interface integrations like ORM, ORU, ADT, SIU, DFT, and VXU on enterprise SaaS hosted databases.
•	Debug the construction and parsing of HL7 messages by analyzing DB and customer specific Java code.
•	Adhoc and exploratory end-to-end testing of the application interface module after RCA is finalized.
•	Analysed around 300 issues in the past year from which  10 were reported as P1 and P2 critical bugs.
•	Involved in mentoring/coaching the team on technical topics by giving presentations and represented the team at the Eclinicalworks National Users Conference.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Worked closely with developers and the project manager to understand each functionality of the Practice Unite app.
•	Designed and implemented test cases using the Robotium framework in Android Studio and KIF framework in Xcode.
•	Performed unit, integration and regression  testing and was able to improve the code coverage to 90%
•	Integrated the testing framework using Jenkins to run one click  automatic builds that would email the test results to the developers. This simplified the process and is efficient in detecting faults in the application.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: Enhanced the Local Authentication Web App in which I designed and implemented the front end web pages using HTML, CSS, JSP and Javascript.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
•	Troubleshoot malfunctions with a number of different applications handled by IBM for clients based in the UK and  intimated application teams in case of any issues to  ensure that the application is working as expected
•	Engaged directly with the customer to understand and troubleshoot issues, collect data, elicit detailed requirements. 
•	Solved business-critical tickets or issues on a daily basis and maintained the SLR’s and SLA’s consistently and hence was hailed as a good performer in the team.

projects.title: Online Fruit Store
projects.description: The  Online Fruits Store is a system that will update the catalog information with data provided by suppliers. The suppliers send the data as large images with an associated description of the products in two files (.TIF for the image and .txt for the description). The images are converted to smaller jpeg images and the text needs to be turned into an HTML file that shows the image and the product description. The contents of the HTML file is  uploaded to a web service that is already running using Django. A python script will process the images and descriptions and then update the online website to add the new products. Once the task is complete, the supplier will be notified through an email that indicates the total weight of fruit (in lbs) that were uploaded. The email will also contain a PDF attached with the name of the fruit and its total weight (in lbs).Finally, in parallel to the automation running, a python script is used to check the health of the system and send an email if something goes wrong.

projects.title: Log report generator using Python
projects.description:
Created a script, named ticky_check.py, that generates two different reports from an internal ticketing system log file i.e., syslog.log. This script will create the following reports:
1. The ranking of errors generated by the system: A list of all the error messages logged and how many times each error was found, sorted by the most common error to the least common error. This report doesn't take into account the users involved.
2. The user usage statistics for the service: A list of all users that have used the system, including how many info messages and how many error messages they've generated. This report is sorted by username.
